answer_1.quote: We extend our evaluation to the auto-regressive LLMs OPT-1.3B, OPT-13B, and LLaMA-2-7B across three representative tasks: text classification, multiple choice, and text generation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in text generation tasks such as question answering (SQuAD) and commonsense reasoning (COPA, CB).

answer_2.quote: We also conducted experiments to OPT-13B model and evaluating its performance on non-differentiable optimization objectives (F1).
